# AnySearch client

Source: https://github.com/anysearch-ai/anysearch-skill
Client version: 3.1.1 (`CLIENT_HEADER`), imported 2026-09-11 from the installed official skill.
Local change (2026-10-11): `search --format json` preserves the original API
envelope for the discovery journal. Markdown remains the default; the HTTP
request and response contents are unchanged. The two upstream documentation
resources are unmodified. LICENSE
and NOTICE accompany this Apache-2.0 distribution. Credentials and runtime.conf
are not included. The client uses built-in Node modules; no npm install is needed.
